newsitem.title: CANADA: NOVA develops new polyethylene technology.
newsitem.headline: NOVA develops new polyethylene technology.

text.p: NOVA Corp unit NOVA Chemicals said on Thursday it developed a new polyethylene manufacturing process aimed at challenging the industry's metallocene resin technology.
NOVA said the Advanced SCLAIRTECH technology would give it a market edge in the chemical product category and that it expected to license the technology wordwide.

The process, tested at NOVA's production facility in Sarnia, Ontario, would allow it to customize resin products to meet high-performance requirements of specialty polyethylene users at lower production costs, NOVA said.
